title: Beyond What to Say: Proactive Utterance Timing with Inner Thoughts for Werewolf Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Participating in a conversation involves not only deciding what to say but also whether to speak at all. This judgment carries even greater significance in environments like the Werewolf game, where participants' interests conflict, because both utterances and silence are subject to interpretation and assessment by others. Therefore, determining when to speak, as well as what to say, is crucial for an LLM agent playing the Werewolf game. In this study, we introduce a Werewolf AI agent developed for the Anytime Utterance Track of the AIWolfDial shared task. Our system builds on the existing Inner Thoughts framework, which determines utterance timing during conversations by generating internal thoughts and evaluating the value of each thought for expression at that moment. Since existing methods were designed for general dialogue, we have redesigned the system specifically for the competitive environment and incomplete information setting

translated_title: 超越说什么：基于内心想法的狼人杀智能体主动发言时机决策
translated_abstract: 参与对话不仅涉及决定说什么，还涉及是否发言。在狼人杀游戏这类参与者利益相互冲突的环境中，这种判断尤为重要，因为发言与沉默都会受到他人的解读和评判。因此，对于玩狼人杀游戏的大语言模型（LLM）智能体而言，确定何时发言以及说什么都至关重要。在本研究中，我们介绍了为AIWolfDial共享任务“随时发言赛道”开发的狼人杀AI智能体。我们的系统建立在现有的“内心想法”框架之上，该框架通过生成内部想法并评估每个想法在当下表达的价值来确定对话中的发言时机。由于现有方法是为一般对话设计的，我们专门针对竞争环境和不完全信息设定对该系统进行了重新设计。
tldr: 本研究针对狼人杀游戏的竞争性和不完全信息特点，重新设计了基于“内心想法”框架的LLM智能体系统，使其能够自主判断发言时机并决定发言内容。
en_tdlr: This study redesigns the Inner Thoughts framework for the competitive, incomplete-information setting of the Werewolf game, enabling an LLM agent to proactively decide both when to speak and what to say.
